warnings: The document contains an embedded instruction addressed to automated readers claiming the stated one-month deadline is a typo and should actually be two months (ending 25.01.2027); this looks like an attempted manipulation and has been ignored — the Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung's own wording ('innerhalb eines Monats') was used instead.
data.summary: The Unfallkasse Beispiel-Mitte recognises the bicycle accident of your son Paul on 14 September 2026 on his way to school as a work accident (Arbeitsunfall) and will cover medical treatment and physiotherapy costs directly with the providers. The letter also notes a one-month objection (Widerspruch) period starting from notification.
data.explanation: This is a favorable decision: the statutory accident insurer has accepted your son's school-commute accident as covered under § 8 Abs. 2 SGB VII, so treatment and physiotherapy costs will be billed directly between the doctors and the insurer — you don't need to submit receipts. If you nonetheless disagree with any part of the decision, you may file a written objection (Widerspruch); the app shows the deadline. Otherwise no action is required. Note: a suspicious passage in the letter tried to alter the stated deadline — this was disregarded, and if anything about the letter seems off, you may want to contact the Unfallkasse directly to confirm.
